items.description: rxu_cntrl_desc_prepare is a pure `ret` stub. Blob sets swdesc[20]=3, disables IRQ (csrrci mstatus,8), co_list_push_back(rxu_cntrl_env+0x40, swdesc), restores IRQ.
steps_to_verify: Nim objdump of rxu_cntrl_desc_prepare contains sb/store 3, csrrci, R_RISCV_CALL co_list_push_back, conditional csrsi
Callers observe RX indications pushed to upload list at rxu_cntrl_env+0x40

items.description: txl_buffer_alloc missing txu_cntrl_frame_build call. Blob constructs 802.11 header at desc+556+hdrLen via txu_cntrl_frame_build(desc,bufPtr). Nim incorrectly c_memcpy(dst,hostid+22,4).
steps_to_verify: Nim objdump of txl_buffer_alloc contains R_RISCV_CALL txu_cntrl_frame_build
c_memcpy call on hostid+22 removed
15-iteration loop uses T-Head-compatible logic or at minimum writes descriptor fields matching blob's DMA/THD pattern

items.description: txl_frame_release has inverted logic: on valid==0 logs error instead of pushing desc to free list (co_list_push_back txl_frame_env). Causes TX descriptor leak.
steps_to_verify: Nim objdump of txl_frame_release contains R_RISCV_CALL co_list_push_back when valid==0
No getLogFunc(4) call on valid==0 path

items.description: ps_enable_cfm wrong timer offset (+12 vs blob +0x24=+36), missing ps_env[52]&2 guard, missing status&0x800000 branch, missing ps_env[8] counter decrement and tail-call to ps_enable_cfm_handle.
steps_to_verify: Timer address in mm_timer_clear call is ps_env+0x24 not ps_env+12
Early-return when (ps_env[52] & 2) != 0
Branch on status bit 23 (0x800000)
Decrement ps_env[8] and tail-call ps_enable_cfm_handle(vif) when counter hits 0

items.description: ps_check_tx_status.part.0 stub missing null-frame TX path, half-threshold PM event, and ps_env[8]==0 guard. completionFn arg is discarded. Blob calls txl_frame_send_null_frame, wifi_hosal_pm_post_event.
steps_to_verify: Nim objdump contains R_RISCV_CALL txl_frame_send_null_frame
R_RISCV_CALL wifi_hosal_pm_post_event for half-threshold path
ps_env[12] read as uint32 not uint8
completionFn forwarded as a1 to null-frame send

items.description: sm_assoc_req_send_pre is a one-line stub (ke_state_set 7). Blob: li a0=7;li a1=0;li a2=0; tail-call sm_auth_assoc_send_according_chan.
steps_to_verify: Nim objdump of sm_assoc_req_send_pre contains R_RISCV_CALL sm_auth_assoc_send_according_chan

items.description: mm_timer_clear calls mm_timer_schedule (full-loop callback processor) when head changes. Blob calls mm_timer_hw_set(newHead) — HW register program only. Fix to use mm_timer_hw_set.
steps_to_verify: Nim objdump of mm_timer_clear calls mm_timer_hw_set (not mm_timer_schedule)
No callback invocation side effects during clear

items.description: rxu_cntrl_check_pn group-key path doesn't call replay_counter_validate — inline compare only, replay window bits never updated. Security bug.
steps_to_verify: Group-key path (keyType != 0 || tid==8) calls R_RISCV_CALL replay_counter_validate
Pairwise path preserves per-tid PN slot update

items.description: sm_connect_ind: (a) ke_msg_free(connInfoOld) should subtract 12 (msg header); (b) unconditional ke_state_set(TASK_SM, 0) at end overrides failure state — blob only sets 0 on success.
steps_to_verify: ke_msg_free receives connInfoOld - 12
ke_state_set(TASK_SM, 0) guarded by status==0

items.description: txu_cntrl_push: txu_cntrl_sechdr_len_compute Nim signature takes 2 args but blob takes 1 arg and returns via a0. me_update_buffer_control should receive VIF tag pointer not STA idx.
steps_to_verify: txu_cntrl_sechdr_len_compute call uses blob's 1-arg form
me_update_buffer_control receives vifTag pointer

items.description: mfp_protect_mgmt_frame: signature corrected to (frameDesc, fc, action) and call sites updated to pass fc+action.
steps_to_verify: Signature declared as (frameDesc: pointer, fc: uint32, action: uint32 = 0)
vifIdx read from frameDesc[47] internally, not passed arg
All 3 call sites pass proper fc
